title: B. Timothy Walsh, MD | Autor | Manual MSD versión para público general
content: B. Timothy Walsh , MD Especialidades y experiencia Psychiatry, Eating Disorders Afiliaciones William and Joy Ruane Professor of Pediatric Psychopharmacology College of Physicians and Surgeons, Columbia University Founding Director, Eating Disorders Research Unit New York State Psychiatric Institute Educación Medical School: Harvard Medical School, Boston, MA Residency: Psychiatry, Bronx Municipal Hospital Center, Bronx, NY Certificaciones American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology – Psychiatry Selección de premios, logros y publicaciones Founder and Former Director of the Columbia Center for Eating Disorders Past President, Academy for Eating Disorders and the Eating Disorders Research Society Chair, Eating Disorders Work Group for both DSM-IV and DSM-V Author, editor, and co-editor of 5 books on adolescent health and eating disorders Recipient of awards from the American Psychiatric Association, the Academy for Eating Disorders, the National Eating Disorders Association, and the Association for Behavior and Cognitive Therapies Over 275 articles in peer-reviewed journals Capítulos y comentarios del manual Capítulos Trastornos de la alimentación
